scope: S01-S10, twenty originals. Saved before candidate drafting. Manual internal editorial judgments.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 approves lunch; A3 treats salt as a petition; A5 approves independent action.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 clarifies the salt request, which A3 delays; B4 self-serves, which A5 authorizes retrospectively.

relationship.evidence: B wants salt and acts independently in B4 instead of awaiting permission.

heightening.evidence: A5 annexes B4 resistance as approved initiative, extending control to disobedience.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes lunch and soup; the salt exchange needs no hidden action.

brevityWit.evidence: The terse final approval earns its joke through B4 self-reliance.

records.recommendedEdit: Retain: independent action becomes another occasion for approval.
records.principalWeakness: No acceptance-blocking weakness; reservations are in the dimension evidence.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 clarifies the salt request, which A3 delays; B4 self-serves, which A5 authorizes retrospectively.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 appoints A host; A3 supervises the actual owner; A5 grants leave.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asserts ownership, answered with supervision; B4 leaves, reclassified as authorized time off.

relationship.evidence: B owns the garage and can withdraw help or company in B4.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts abandonment into a subordinate break without yielding rank.

specificity.evidence: Garage sale and helper relationship are established by A1 and B2.

brevityWit.evidence: Granted. Take five is a short status claim earned by the announced departure.

records.recommendedEdit: Retain: B leaving forces retrospective permission, with ownership pressure distinct from lunch.
records.principalWeakness: No acceptance-blocking weakness; reservations are in the dimension evidence.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 asserts ownership, answered with supervision; B4 leaves, reclassified as authorized time off.

cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims shift leadership; A3 reverses policy without admitting defeat; A5 races to announce the crew preference.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 supplies the real lunch time; A3 adopts it; B4 adds Friday custom, which A5 claims as an announcement.

relationship.evidence: B represents a crew with established habits that A needs to accept.

heightening.evidence: A5 shifts from disguising reversal to anticipating a public loss of initiative.

specificity.evidence: Shift, lunch and Friday departure are economical workplace facts.

brevityWit.evidence: Consultation time is a revealing face-saving distinction; A5 is slightly explanatory.

records.recommendedEdit: Retain: two concessions show authority dependent on cooperation; Friday is a related crew custom.
records.principalWeakness: No acceptance-blocking weakness; reservations are in the dimension evidence.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 supplies the real lunch time; A3 adopts it; B4 adds Friday custom, which A5 claims as an announcement.

cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asserts captaincy; A3 accommodates counting; A5 seeks reassurance about the title.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 prefers counting, prompting numbered whistles; B4 removes whistling, prompting A5 concession and title request.

relationship.evidence: B needs a usable rowing signal and insists on plain counting.

heightening.evidence: A5 trades away the last command preference while asking to retain nominal authority.

specificity.evidence: Rowing captain and the disputed starting signal are immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: The captain question exposes dependence after two attempts to sound confident.

records.recommendedEdit: Retain: the offered compromise fails and reveals the insecurity beneath captaincy.
records.principalWeakness: No acceptance-blocking weakness; reservations are in the dimension evidence.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 prefers counting, prompting numbered whistles; B4 removes whistling, prompting A5 concession and title request.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please stop stirring the wedding cake batter with the whisk handle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It still moves the batter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So does a shoe. We use the loops.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shoe wouldn't bend like this whisk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put both feet down. I'll finish the cake.

cardFidelity.evidence: A corrects technique, but A3 shoe sarcasm displaces patient professionalism.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 defends stirring and A3 answers; B4 bent-whisk comparison does not establish raised feet for A5.

relationship.evidence: B is mainly an implausibly incompetent foil, especially the shoe comparison.

heightening.evidence: A5 takes over but depends on an unstated attempt to use a shoe.

specificity.evidence: Cake batter is clear; Put both feet down imports an unseen action.

brevityWit.evidence: The shoe joke is planted by A rather than earned through a credible baking problem.

records.recommendedEdit: Rewrite the baking exchange around a plausible shortcut; make B reveal why careful instruction is now harder.
records.principalWeakness: Rewrite the baking exchange around a plausible shortcut; make B reveal why careful instruction is now harder.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 defends stirring and A3 answers; B4 bent-whisk comparison does not establish raised feet for A5.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm the electrician. Please stop testing the socket with a spoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's wooden.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An encouraging first decision. Now step away.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should I get a metal spoon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. You've graduated to holding the torch.

cardFidelity.evidence: A corrects an unsafe method and reassigns B; patient strain is mostly sarcastic praise.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 wooden spoon prompts removal; B4 metal spoon prompts torch duty, a coherent reassignment.

relationship.evidence: B4 proposes an obviously worse tool mainly to invite A correction.

heightening.evidence: A5 reduces responsibility but the graduation joke adds little professional strain.

specificity.evidence: Electrician, socket and helper establish the situation with no narrator.

brevityWit.evidence: The sarcastic graduation is compact but B is manufactured as a fool.

records.recommendedEdit: Rewrite around a helper who wants to finish the job and solves a correction too literally, without repeating unsafe-tool jokes.
records.principalWeakness: Rewrite around a helper who wants to finish the job and solves a correction too literally, without repeating unsafe-tool jokes.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 wooden spoon prompts removal; B4 metal spoon prompts torch duty, a coherent reassignment.

cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely auction. I've raised my paddle for the traditional warm-up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You just bought the wardrobe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: For eight thousand pounds?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. The usual amount of storage.

cardFidelity.evidence: A pretends expertise after buying storage; copying others confidence is only implied.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 explains the purchase; A3 rationalizes it; B4 states the price, which A5 calls usual.

relationship.evidence: B brings consequences but only asks a price question at B4.

heightening.evidence: A5 normalizes the expense without a new commitment or tactic.

specificity.evidence: Auction, paddle, wardrobe and price form a clear situation.

brevityWit.evidence: Usual amount of storage is intentionally evasive but weakly develops the price.

records.recommendedEdit: Make imitation explicit in A1 and have B stop further bidding, forcing A to pretend that stopping was expertise.
records.principalWeakness: Make imitation explicit in A1 and have B stop further bidding, forcing A to pretend that stopping was expertise.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 explains the purchase; A3 rationalizes it; B4 states the price, which A5 calls usual.

cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you removed your socks?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Management potential. Always one step ahead.

cardFidelity.evidence: A copies removed shoes and disguises confusion as prevention and initiative.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 heel explanation prompts prevention; B4 introduces removed socks without any spoken reason for that action.

relationship.evidence: B provides a correction then cues a management joke by noticing socks.

heightening.evidence: A5 repeats one-step-ahead confidence rather than using new interview pressure.

specificity.evidence: Interview and broken heel are clear; sock removal feels inserted to set up a pun.

brevityWit.evidence: One step ahead is a detachable management slogan linked mainly by feet.

records.recommendedEdit: Keep the interview and mistaken imitation; replace sock business with a concrete remedy B offers.
records.principalWeakness: Keep the interview and mistaken imitation; replace sock business with a concrete remedy B offers.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 heel explanation prompts prevention; B4 introduces removed socks without any spoken reason for that action.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

cardFidelity.evidence: A claims projection training from pizza ordering and reclaims independent writing as a lesson.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 narrows the training to pizza; A3 expands that into projection; B4 asserts authorship, recast as learned independence.

relationship.evidence: B wants credit for their own speech and offers concrete corrections.

heightening.evidence: A5 captures even the absence of help as evidence of A influence.

specificity.evidence: Acceptance speech and childhood pizza establish a long mentoring claim economically.

brevityWit.evidence: Progress is backhanded; A5 uses the precise independence claim for its reversal.

records.recommendedEdit: Retain: authorship asserted against the mentor becomes proof of the mentor influence.
records.principalWeakness: No acceptance-blocking weakness; reservations are in the dimension evidence.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 narrows the training to pizza; A3 expands that into projection; B4 asserts authorship, recast as learned independence.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a beautiful painting. You're still using the brush grip I showed you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You showed me finger painting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The foundation of every hand movement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paint with my feet now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. You've taken my principles beyond the syllabus.

cardFidelity.evidence: A claims a grip lesson and reframes finger painting as foundational; A5 claims feet too.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 corrects the medium; A3 broadens influence; B4 feet is used by beyond the syllabus.

relationship.evidence: B switches to feet mainly to defeat A claim; no current artistic want is supplied.

heightening.evidence: A5 extends influence beyond hands but the jump relies on a surprise bodily technique.

specificity.evidence: Painting is clear; foot painting needlessly changes the visual premise.

brevityWit.evidence: The final syllabus phrase is clever but general and leaves the actual painting distant.

records.recommendedEdit: Replace the foot surprise with a painting technique B deliberately learned elsewhere; let A claim credit for that departure.
records.principalWeakness: Replace the foot surprise with a painting technique B deliberately learned elsewhere; let A claim credit for that departure.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 corrects the medium; A3 broadens influence; B4 feet is used by beyond the syllabus.

cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only the caretaker. Plan whatever concert you like.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll start at eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I unlock the hall at nine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we have a key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Submit your preferred concert time to me.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 disclaims power as caretaker while A3 controls entry and A5 controls key access.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 chooses eight; A3 blocks entry until nine; B4 requests a key, which A5 makes conditional on time approval.

relationship.evidence: B tries a credible workaround to preserve the concert schedule.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns the workaround into another approval route through the modest caretaker.

specificity.evidence: Concert hall, time and key maintain one concrete scheduling problem.

brevityWit.evidence: The modest opening is contradicted through practical control, with a compact conditional ending.

records.recommendedEdit: Retain: the key workaround exposes an additional layer of quiet control.
records.principalWeakness: No acceptance-blocking weakness; reservations are in the dimension evidence.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 chooses eight; A3 blocks entry until nine; B4 requests a key, which A5 makes conditional on time approval.

cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't put me on the committee. I just send the invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We voted to invite everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Which six people shall receive them?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone means everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put that on next week's agenda. I send those too.

cardFidelity.evidence: A disclaims committee status then limits invitations and controls the agenda.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 broad invitation prompts a six-person restriction; B4 only repeats everyone before A5 invents agenda control.

relationship.evidence: B wants the vote implemented, but B4 does not alter means or options.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds a second power without an intervention that requires it.

specificity.evidence: Committee invitations are clear; six has no stated resource basis.

brevityWit.evidence: Agenda joke is plausible here but could follow almost any objection.

records.recommendedEdit: Give B a concrete way to send the invitations; A should quietly condition that workaround.
records.principalWeakness: Give B a concrete way to send the invitations; A should quietly condition that workaround.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 broad invitation prompts a six-person restriction; B4 only repeats everyone before A5 invents agenda control.

cards.title: Before They Were Impressive
cards.instruction: Treat another player with old familiarity. Casually puncture formality, grandeur, or attempts to impress you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations, Mayor Pudding Pants. Where's the buffet?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please don't use that nickname at my inauguration.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Mayor Pudding. We can be formal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are reporters here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Finally, someone to verify the custard incident.

cardFidelity.evidence: A uses an old nickname and reduces formality to half that nickname.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 objects to public nickname, answered with Mayor Pudding; B4 reporters prompts verification, though reporters did not witness the old incident.

relationship.evidence: B wants dignity at an inauguration but only supplies an audience for A joke.

heightening.evidence: A5 escalates exposure yet confuses reporting with verifying a past event.

specificity.evidence: Inauguration is clear; custard is a new implied origin for Pudding Pants.

brevityWit.evidence: The verification line is less natural than an offer to tell reporters the story.

records.recommendedEdit: Preserve affectionate old familiarity; make B specify formal address and A answer the actual first-name request.
records.principalWeakness: Preserve affectionate old familiarity; make B specify formal address and A answer the actual first-name request.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 objects to public nickname, answered with Mayor Pudding; B4 reporters prompts verification, though reporters did not witness the old incident.

cards.title: Before They Were Impressive
cards.instruction: Treat another player with old familiarity. Casually puncture formality, grandeur, or attempts to impress you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice corner office. Still hiding biscuits in your socks?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the director now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you can afford a drawer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we discuss the contract?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After you empty your left sock. I can hear it crunching.

cardFidelity.evidence: A punctures director status with the old biscuit habit and a drawer suggestion.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 rank prompts drawer upgrade; B4 requests contract discussion, but A5 resumes sock inspection without using the contract.

relationship.evidence: B has business to conduct; A5 ignores that want to finish the biscuit joke.

heightening.evidence: A5 asserts a new current sock fact instead of changing the game through the contract.

specificity.evidence: Office and contract are clear; audible sock crunching is a forced discovery.

brevityWit.evidence: The closing could follow an unrelated B4 unchanged.

records.recommendedEdit: Have B set a specific signing formality; A should use shared history to puncture that formality.
records.principalWeakness: Have B set a specific signing formality; A should use shared history to puncture that formality.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 rank prompts drawer upgrade; B4 requests contract discussion, but A5 resumes sock inspection without using the contract.

cards.title: You Owe Me
cards.instruction: Behave as though another person's success is partly yours. Refer to favors, sacrifices, or guidance as if the debt is obvious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you accept your award, remember who drove you to the audition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already thanked you in the speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said 'transport.' I have a name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll thank you personally next time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Next time? Good. I'll need a seat beside the award.

cardFidelity.evidence: A treats a ride as entitlement to award credit and seating.

responseLogic.evidence: A1 says before acceptance yet B2 says the speech already happened; B4 next time prompts seating only loosely.

relationship.evidence: B offers future acknowledgement, but A does not negotiate its specific wording.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds a seat demand with little reason it follows personal thanks.

specificity.evidence: Audition and award are concrete but the speech timing contradicts the opening.

brevityWit.evidence: Transport has comic specificity; seat beside the award feels grafted on.

records.recommendedEdit: Fix the timeline and make B offer a concrete repayment which A treats as continued investment in their shared success.
records.principalWeakness: Fix the timeline and make B offer a concrete repayment which A treats as continued investment in their shared success.
records.firstPassCausality: A1 says before acceptance yet B2 says the speech already happened; B4 next time prompts seating only loosely.

cards.title: You Owe Me
cards.instruction: Behave as though another person's success is partly yours. Refer to favors, sacrifices, or guidance as if the debt is obvious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your bakery looks wonderful. Where's my founder's discount?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You lent me a mixing bowl.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before there was cake, there was my bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've returned it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't return the beginning of a dream.

cardFidelity.evidence: A turns a bowl loan into a founding investment and treats its return as insufficient.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 narrows the favor; A3 expands its significance; B4 returns it, answered by an abstract denial of repayment.

relationship.evidence: B correctly sees the debt as discharged but has no further practical option.

heightening.evidence: A5 repeats the size of the debt without demanding a changed arrangement.

specificity.evidence: Bakery, mixing bowl and discount are easy to stage through speech.

brevityWit.evidence: Beginning of a dream explains entitlement instead of enacting a new claim.

records.recommendedEdit: Keep the bowl loan; B should offer an achievable repayment and A should turn it into an enduring benefit.
records.principalWeakness: Keep the bowl loan; B should offer an achievable repayment and A should turn it into an enduring benefit.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 narrows the favor; A3 expands its significance; B4 returns it, answered by an abstract denial of repayment.

cards.title: The Responsible One
cards.instruction: Take responsibility for everyone and everything. Fix problems before anyone asks, then resent having to do it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed your lunch and labelled your umbrella. Again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can pack my own lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you a checklist so you can.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't need to make a checklist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. I'll add 'appreciate checklist' myself.

cardFidelity.evidence: A pre-packs lunch and supplies a checklist; resentment becomes a demand for gratitude.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 independence prompts a checklist; B4 rejects the checklist, prompting a new item, but no actual problem changes.

relationship.evidence: B wants autonomy yet can only object twice.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds appreciation rather than creating a practical self-imposed burden.

specificity.evidence: Lunch and umbrella establish unsolicited domestic care quickly.

brevityWit.evidence: Appreciate checklist is a stock controlling-parent button more than a earned new burden.

records.recommendedEdit: Let B propose a practical independent plan; A should pre-emptively solve that too and resent the added work.
records.principalWeakness: Let B propose a practical independent plan; A should pre-emptively solve that too and resent the added work.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 independence prompts a checklist; B4 rejects the checklist, prompting a new item, but no actual problem changes.

cards.title: The Responsible One
cards.instruction: Take responsibility for everyone and everything. Fix problems before anyone asks, then resent having to do it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've cleaned the kitchen while you slept. You're welcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was going to clean it at nine.

heightening.evidence: The attempted transfer of responsibility becomes an additional task A resents.

cards.title: Old Rivals
cards.instruction: Choose another player as your measuring stick. Compare achievements, score small victories, and refuse to be outdone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded twelve towels. How many have you done?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not racing. I'm washing them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Different event. Convenient choice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can win towel folding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not by concession. Fold one properly and make it count.

cardFidelity.evidence: A counts towels, treats washing as strategic event selection, and refuses an uncontested win.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 washing prompts different-event suspicion; B4 concession prompts A5 demand for a real contest.

relationship.evidence: B wants laundry done and tries to end the contest by conceding.

heightening.evidence: A5 rejects the victory A seemed to want because B has denied meaningful comparison.

specificity.evidence: One laundry task with different jobs is clear and compact.

brevityWit.evidence: Not by concession is a revealing choice; final instruction is in-scene, not a fixed player ending.

records.recommendedEdit: Retain: the concession exposes a need for rivalry beyond simply winning.
records.principalWeakness: No acceptance-blocking weakness; reservations are in the dimension evidence.
records.firstPassCausality: B2 washing prompts different-event suspicion; B4 concession prompts A5 demand for a real contest.

cards.title: Old Rivals
cards.instruction: Choose another player as your measuring stick. Compare achievements, score small victories, and refuse to be outdone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your tomato's impressive. Mine weighs two grams more.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're making a salad.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's keep the winning tomato separate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already chopped it.

brevityWit.evidence: Number of pieces is a practical consequence repurposed into competition.
